title: Archive through August 11, 2003 - Anonymous (Monday, August 11, 2003 - 09:01 pm)
content: At the age of 8, I went in diabetic coma. Doctors said I would die if I didn't make it by 5pm. I woke up at 4:45pm. I was alive. :-) I spent the next 2 weeks in hospital as I was diagnosed with "juvenile diabetes" - First in Fiji. Anyway, I was getting better when one night while I was waiting for my parents to come and visit me, I dosed off. When I woke up, I saw a guy sitting at the end of my bed; I couldn't see the face. I thought it was my dad so I said "Dad"...and he looked around...He was faceless! The guy had NO FACE! I screamed. He got up and said to me "come with me" and put his hand forward. I was screaming and refused to go but to my amazement...I was moving. We both started flying and up we went. I realized I was up near the hospital roof and could see myself lying on the bed down below. Next thing...we were in a dark eerie place. I was standing in a pew with a few people. Then someone pushed the two ladies in the front in a ball of fire. The guy who pushed them was so tall, dark and very scary. We moved to another pew and 2 people were pushed to a BIG SHARK who started eating them. I saw big glasses breaking etc. Then next I know is, I was back on the hospital roof. I could see lots of nurses and doctors around my body doing something. I started falling down, and in I went in my body! I still remember every single detail of it...20 years have gone but nothing can delete that experience.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Flying upward with a faceless man; later in a dark eerie place; then back to the hospital roof and falling into the body.

arrival.other_being_detail: A faceless man who said 'come with me'; later a very tall, dark, scary being who pushed people into punishments.

environment.environment_other_detail: A 'dark eerie place' with pews; ball of fire; a big shark; breaking glass.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Diabetic coma ('juvenile diabetes') at age 8; experience occurred during hospitalization (after dosing off).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Faceless being invited the child to 'come with me'; frightening punitive scenes (fire, shark).
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE/flying upward to hospital roof, then to a dark eerie place with pews and punishments, then back to roof observing staff around body, then falling back into body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Faceless man at end of bed; punitive scenes involving a ball of fire and a shark eating people; 'big glasses breaking'.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "come with me"; "He was faceless! The guy had NO FACE!"; "Next thing...we were in a dark eerie place."; "I started falling down, and in I went in my body!"
